sources.finding: Vision config depth=24 hidden_size=1024 out_hidden_size=2560 patch_size=16 spatial_merge_size=2 and deepstack_visual_indexes=[] in current 4B config.
server process_mtmd_chunk retrieves mtmd_batch_get_output_embd and passes that embedding buffer into mtmd_helper_decode_image_chunk; this is a real encode/decode seam.
Closed issue reports Qwen3.5 multi-turn images being reprocessed on later turns, motivating explicit encode-reuse measurement rather than cache assumptions.
Qwen3-VL-Embedding uses multi-stage contrastive pretraining and reranker distillation, counterevidence to assuming raw generative VLM features are already calibrated embeddings.
VLM2Vec explicitly trains VLMs with contrastive objectives for multimodal embedding behavior; supports retaining a learned/tuned readout counterbaseline.
Adaptive spatial visual-token reduction plus temporal continuity can reduce GUI-agent token/latency cost; supports ROI/token-budget experiments, not a fixed Frank threshold.
Historical GUI screenshot pruning work indicates static/background spatial structure and recency can matter; supports ROI+context and periodic-anchor controls.
Action-grounded local visual memory is reported to outperform naive full-image memory in GUI agents; supports Frank action-linked crop-memory experiments.

promotion_rule: External findings refine hypotheses/tests only; none is target-runtime proof.
